parse.title: Green Alien (Fusion)
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 14 - Sword Art Online Update

Overview

Green Alien (Fusion) is a Secret Limited unit. He is only obtainable by clearing stage 4 or 5 of the West City raid with a 1% and 5% chance respectively.

Evolving

Green Alien (Fusion) can evolve into Green Alien (Nameless) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
